title: Rollout controller: respect quality gate for canary promotion
author: Hannah Rivera
release_notes: Rollout controller now blocks canary promotion when the associated Optimize quality gate is not PASSED (FAILED/OVERRIDDEN/UNKNOWN). Adds notifications and audit events for promotion blocks.
description:
Title: Rollout controller: respect quality gate for canary promotion

Context
Optimize can propose cost-saving config diffs (batching, caching, quantization profile) that require mandatory quality gates before being applied to production. We already enforce at the Optimize “apply config” boundary, but we also need defense-in-depth at rollout time to prevent a canary from being promoted (or progressing) when gates are failing or missing.

What this PR does
- Adds a quality-gate check stage to rollout controller promotion flow (canary -> next step / full rollout).
- Hard-blocks promotion unless the referenced gate run is in PASSED state.
- Treats FAILED, PENDING, RUNNING, CANCELED, and UNKNOWN as non-promotable.
- Treats OVERRIDDEN as non-promotable for now (follow-up: policy-driven allowlist for specific account tiers + explicit override reason codes).
- Posts a notification when promotion is blocked (internal notifications service + optional Slack channel routing) with gate_run_id, route, model, config_diff_id, and top failure reasons.
- Emits an audit event for “rollout_promotion_blocked_quality_gate” (consumed by Console audit views).
- Adds retry/backoff for transient Optimize API errors; defaults to block-on-error.

Key behaviors / policy
- We block promotion at the point of requesting promotion, not on every status poll.
- Gate lookup is tied to the rollout’s config_diff_id (coming from Optimize recommendation/apply flow). If config_diff_id is missing, promotion is blocked with explicit reason “missing_gate_reference”.
- If Optimize API returns 404 for gate_run_id, promotion is blocked with reason “gate_not_found”.
- If gate run is PASSED but older than the rollout’s latest config revision, promotion is blocked with reason “stale_gate_run” (prevents promoting after last-minute edits).

Implementation notes
- New dependency: rollout-controller now calls Optimize service GateRuns API (GET /v1/gates/runs/{id}) and validates state + timestamps.
- Adds internal type GateRunStatus with explicit mapping from Optimize enum values.
- Adds Notification payload schema for promotion-block events (kept small; links point to Console gate run page).
- Adds metrics:
  - rollout_promotion_quality_gate_check_total{result=pass|block|error, reason=...}
  - rollout_promotion_quality_gate_check_latency_ms
- Adds structured logs with request_id, rollout_id, gate_run_id, config_diff_id.

Testing
- Unit tests for state mapping + policy decisions.
- Integration tests with stubbed Optimize API: PASSED allows promotion; FAILED/PENDING/UNKNOWN blocks.
- Load-safe: guardrail to avoid thundering herd; gate check only on explicit promotion calls.

Rollout / risk
- This is a behavior change (promotion can now be blocked). Default is conservative: block on missing/unknown/error.
- Notifications are rate-limited per rollout_id to avoid spam in noisy failure modes.

Follow-ups
- Add policy flag to optionally allow OVERRIDDEN promotion for enterprise-only routes with explicit approvers (ties into override policy + audit trail). (tracked in ENG-3972)
- Wire blocked promotion to auto-halt canary progression UI state in Console (Console will already see promotion failure response; UI improvements tracked in ENG-3925).

Refs
- Linear: ENG-3928
- Related PRs: pr-19531 (block apply when gate fails), pr-19537 (override flow), pr-19593 (metrics/tracing for gates)

Checklist
- [x] Added tests
- [x] Added metrics + logs
- [x] Added notification for blocked promotion
- [x] Documented failure reasons in code comments
- [x] Verified no promotion happens on transient Optimize API errors (block-on-error)
